title: QA Automation Tester
description:
**Job Title**

**QA Automation Tester**

**Job Details**

* **Location:** Gurugram (On-site only)
* **Eligible Candidates:** Gurugram / nearby locations only
* **Joining:** Immediate (1–4 days max)
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Industry:** Technology, Information & Internet
* **Reporting To:** Project Manager / Delivery Head

**Role Overview**

* Selenium automation is the **primary responsibility**
* Strong manual and regression testing ownership
* Handle release-critical testing and final sign-offs
* Ensure quality, security, and stability of production systems
* Work directly with buyers / clients on quality expectations

**Automation Testing (Primary – Mandatory)**

* Design, build, and maintain **Selenium automation suites**
* Execute automation for functional and regression testing
* Analyze failures and maintain stable automation frameworks
* Manage test data and improve automation coverage
* Ensure automation reliability across releases

**Manual & Regression Testing**

* Independently handle complex manual testing
* Perform deep regression testing before releases
* Create high-quality test scenarios and test cases
* Validate fixes and support UAT
* Contribute confidently to final release sign-off

**Security & Risk Testing (Mandatory)**

* Validate authentication and authorization flows
* Test role-based access and session security
* Identify security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
* Perform security-focused and penetration-style testing
* Ensure data protection and compliance standards

**AI & Modern QA Tools**

* Use AI-assisted testing tools for efficiency
* Improve defect detection and test optimization
* Adapt to modern QA platforms and tools

**Client / Buyer Collaboration**

* Work directly with buyers and stakeholders
* Align on acceptance criteria and quality benchmarks
* Participate in demos, UAT, and defect triage
* Communicate clearly and professionally

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain automation reports and execution summaries
* Write clear test cases and defect logs
* Document security findings with impact analysis
* Provide regular and transparent status updates

**Must-Have Skills (Senior Level)**

* Strong expertise in **Selenium Automation**
* Extensive manual and regression testing experience
* Defect tracking using **JIRA** or similar tools
* Clean release sign-off experience
* Excellent written and spoken English
* High ownership and accountability mindset

**Good to Have**

* Automation frameworks (TestNG, JUnit, etc.)
* API testing experience
* Agile / fast-paced delivery exposure
* Buyer or client-facing QA experience
* Hands-on use of AI-driven testing tools
* Docker and fast API

**Performance Expectations**

* High automation coverage with minimal escape defects
* Stable regression and security cycles
* Reduced release risk and production issues
* Strong collaboration with developers and buyers
* Continuous improvement in automation quality

**Clear Role Commitment**

* Own **automation, regression, and security quality end-to-end**
* Protect sensitive data and reduce release risk
* Deliver disciplined, defect-free releases

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Software Development Engineer in Test**

Location Gurugram - Haryana, India

FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. With currently around 34,000 employees at over 125 locations, the company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of €8.0 billion in the fiscal year 2025.

**YOUR TASKS**

About the Role  
We are looking for a Senior SDET with 6–8+ years of relevant experience to design and develop scalable test automation solutions across UI, API, system integration, and end-to-end testing.  
The role combines software engineering, test automation, CI/CD, cloud, and AI-assisted development. The ideal candidate is a strong Python developer with hands-on experience in modern automation frameworks and a mindset for continuous improvement.  
Key Responsibilities  

Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks and architectures.

Define and implement test automation strategies, including appropriate test levels, coverage, and risk-based testing.  

Develop automated tests for UI, API, system integration, and end-to-end testing.  

Build automation using Python, Pytest, Selenium, Playwright, and Appium.  

Integrate automated testing into Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.  

Improve automation coverage, stability, execution efficiency, and reporting.  

Work with AWS-based environments to support scalable test execution.  

Use PowerShell and scripting to automate test execution, environment setup, and supporting engineering tasks.  

Use GitHub Copilot and AI/LLM-based tools for code generation, test creation, debugging, refactoring, and test analysis.  

Explore and implement AI-driven approaches to improve test automation and engineering productivity.  

Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment

Mentor team members and contribute to automation strategy and technology evolution.

 **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS**  
Required Skills & Qualifications  

* 6–8+ years of relevant experience in software testing, test automation, or SDET

roles.  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, such as

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science.  

* Strong Python programming and object-oriented design skills.
* Strong hands-on experience with Pytest.
* Experience designing test automation architecture, frameworks, reusable

components, and test strategies.  

* Proven experience with Selenium and/or Playwright; Appium experience is an

advantage.  

* Strong experience in REST API testing and automation.
* Practical experience with Jenkins, GitLab, and Git.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or scripting for automation and engineering

tasks.  

* Basic working knowledge of AWS and cloud-based environments.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development

tools.  

* Good understanding of software testing, QA methodologies, and quality

engineering practices.  

* Good working knowledge of HTML/CSS.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have  

* System Integration Testing (SIT) experience.
* Performance testing experience.
* Experience with AI-driven test automation or LLM-based testing solutions.
* Docker/containerization experience.
* Automotive domain knowledge.
* Basics of Embedded Systems

  
  
Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company.
  
  
FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity.

**HELLA India Autoparts & Services**

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Designation**:QA Automation Engineer

**Experience:** 3\-5 Years

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Salary:** Best in industry

**Location:** Gurgaon, India (work from office only)

We are looking for an **Automation QA Engineer** who does not wait to be handed a bug. You will design and own the systems that continuously test our platforms across web, mobile, and **APIs**, **flagging issues** before they reach users. You will use **AI proficiently** as part of your workflow, not as a novelty but as a tool that makes your testing sharper and your coverage broader. This is a hands\-on role. You will build, maintain, and improve automation frameworks, set up monitoring systems, and work closely with the Product team to keep quality high across every release.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Write detailed, maintainable testing scripts that cover functional, regression, and edge case scenarios.
* Design and implement **automated test suites** across web applications and API layers using **Playwright**, **Selenium**, or **Cypress**.
* Core **Python** or **JavaScript** is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with **AI \& Automation** with **Playwright Agents**.
* Set up **continuous monitoring systems** that test live environments on an ongoing basis, not just at release time.
* Identify, document, and raise bugs in **Jira** with clarity and enough context for developers to act fast.
* Use **AI tools** to enhance test coverage, generate test cases, and identify edge cases that manual testing would miss.
* Work with the Product team to understand new features early and build test coverage before release.
* Maintain and improve existing automation frameworks as products evolve.
* Report on test results, coverage gaps, and system health in a structured and consistent way.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in QA automation?
* Which QA automation tools are you proficient in? Please list them below.
* Are you comfortable with commuting or relocating to the job's location?
* Your last drawn CTC (in lakhs per annum)
* Your availability to join (in days)

description:
We are a technology\-driven organization supporting a high\-volume e\-commerce and logistics platform on AWS Linux servers. Our infrastructure runs on large\-scale automation including shell scripts, cron jobs, file transfers, data feeds, and Oracle integrations.

We are looking for a **hands\-on Linux Automation Engineer** (not a traditional SysAdmin) to build, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize mission\-critical automation systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize shell scripts and automation workflows
* Troubleshoot production issues (scripts, cron jobs, data feeds, file transfers)
* Improve automation for reliability, performance, and scalability
* Build new automation solutions for business operations
* Manage and monitor large\-scale cron jobs
* Handle file processing, log analysis, and data pipelines
* Work with FTP, SFTP, SCP, Rsync for file transfers
* Integrate automation with Oracle databases
* Build monitoring, alerting, and reporting tools
* Document workflows and support production incidents

**Required Skills**

* 4 years Linux/Unix experience
* Strong Bash/shell scripting expertise
* Deep knowledge of Linux commands, systems, and process management
* Experience with cron scheduling and job management
* Strong troubleshooting skills
* Experience with file transfers (FTP, SFTP, SCP, Rsync, SSH)
* Handling large files and automated data feeds
* Linux file systems, permissions, and ownership understanding
* Oracle DB experience (**Mandatory**)
* Experience writing production\-grade scripts
* Familiarity with AWS Linux environments

**Preferred Location for Candidates: Delhi and Nearby Areas**  
**Work Shift \- US EST Working Hours**

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Laxmi Nagar, Delhi, Delhi
